calculation.description: When at least 75% of available tradable instruments have negative three-day returns, rank the lagged three-day reversal signal across instruments. The stress condition is lagged one completed day to prevent look-ahead.

validation.period: 2020-01-01 through latest completed data available at 2027-02-25
validation.regime_notes: Sparse stress-conditional signal. Validation uses all 15 tradable benchmark instruments and requires at least 8 valid names per date. Validation dates are cross-sectional IC observations, while active dates count signal-regime dates. Threshold sweep was supportive: 0.60 IC 0.06918/ICIR 0.17645; 0.67, 0.75 and 0.80 each IC 0.08463/ICIR 0.22152. Interpret uncertainty conservatively because only 114 cross-sectional IC dates are active.
